The second `pnpm test` run has finished and still fails in both locales. All of its failures are timeouts or waits that ran out while the machine was heavily loaded. I've added the results to the handback as §10.

| Locale | unit-node | unit-web | formula |
|---|---|---|---|
| unset | 2259/2268 | 1533/1534 | 259 passed, 2 skipped |
| C.UTF-8 | 2260/2268 | 1532/1534 | 259 passed, 2 skipped |

The failures fall into three groups:
- **`architecture.test.ts`:** timed out after 30 seconds. It is not a boundary violation, and it passes 139/139 when run on its own after my fix.
- **`packages/reporting` PDF tests:** 5-second timeouts. These are in BE-N2's area.
- **`raid.test.tsx` in the web app:** a wait for a link ran out. It passed 1534/1534 in the first run, and I changed no web files.

Still to do: one clean `pnpm test` in each locale and one clean `pnpm test:integration`, run on a quieter machine. The integration suite crashed both times I ran it. The fix itself is finished and uncommitted on `dg5/kbe-d3`.
